scripts.build: pnpm run logo && vite build && node scripts/inject-jsonld.mjs
scripts.build:colorful: pnpm run logo && vite build --mode colorful && node scripts/inject-jsonld.mjs
scripts.deploy: pnpm run build:colorful && node scripts/deploy.mjs gh-pages
scripts.build:hostinger: pnpm run logo && pnpm run og && vite build --base=/ && node scripts/prerender.mjs
scripts.deploy:hostinger: pnpm run build:hostinger && node scripts/deploy.mjs hostinger
